mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, role, content, sources_json, token_usage, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_message (conversation_id, role, content, sources_json, token_usage, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sourcesJson}, #{tokenUsage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM qa_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC
